site.title: Back From The Dead Productions
site.description: Back From The Dead Productions is a creatively driven production company crafting groundbreaking movies and documentaries based on true stories. Founded by filmmaker Richie Smyth in Los Angeles.
site.ogDescription: Visualising Truth, Passion and Imagination. A Richie Smyth Production Company.

items.title: Zarqawi
items.logline: A CIA agent must go rogue in an attempt to stop the world's greatest new terrorist since Bin Laden.
synopsis: In the chaotic aftermath of the Iraq invasion, a seasoned CIA operative finds himself sidelined by bureaucracy while Abu Musab al-Zarqawi builds a network of terror across the Middle East. When official channels fail, our protagonist makes a fateful decision: go rogue.
Based on extensively researched true events, Zarqawi is a taut, morally complex thriller that explores the human cost of the War on Terror.

items.title: Fighting Charity
items.logline: After a young girl is abandoned by her family, she returns 20 years later to confront them, but in turn ignites a blood-feud.
synopsis: Charity Sheridan is a scrappy nine-year old girl from a family of Irish travellers who dreams of becoming a professional boxer. In her eyes, life is perfect, she worships her bare-knuckle champion dad, her tight-knit family, and her roam-free life. When she accidentally kills a boy from a rival family, a vicious inter-family feud is ignited, and her own family has no option but to send her away until tensions subside. When her family never returns, she grows up in foster care, emotionally broken and angry at a world that discarded her.

items.title: The Dechert Incident
items.logline: A geo-political thriller following two men targeted by a powerful law firm for exposing an international financial crime syndicate originating in Iran.
synopsis: When two whistleblowers stumble upon evidence of an international financial crime syndicate stretching from Tehran to London and Dubai, they believe the truth will set them free. Instead, it makes them targets.

The Dechert Incident is a multi-part documentary series featuring exclusive access to the whistleblowers and the mounting evidence of a cover-up that reaches the highest levels of international power.

items.title: New Universal Human
items.logline: Enter the multiverse, a world of stories set in the fantastic imagination of Tohl Narita.
synopsis: Watch the rise to power of the URIN in the cities above the chemical cloud. While below on a scorched Earth the last of the hydrosphere forces humans out into the ocean deserts seeking water. Urin Ring, the oldest son of Urin Mother cast down to Earth, is building an army, one that will soon rise and take back his rightful throne.

items.title: Jadotville Jacks
items.logline: The true story of Ireland’s UN soldiers at Jadotville, how they survived a five day siege in 1961, and why the fight for recognition lasted a lifetime.
synopsis: In September 1961, 150 Irish UN troops, some as young as 18, were surrounded and besieged for five days in the Congolese mining town of Jadotville. Outnumbered and outgunned, A Company fought with extraordinary discipline, inflicting heavy losses while sustaining no fatalities. Yet when the battle ended, they were ordered to surrender, and returned home to silence, stigma, and decades of official neglect.

items.title: Ramree Island
items.logline: A platoon of Japanese soldiers attempt to ambush an Allied invasion by crossing an island infested with sea crocodiles.
synopsis: In the waning days of World War II, young Imperial Army private Ryusei Tanaka joins legendary commander General Hiroshi Yamada on a mission to reinforce Japanese forces on Ramree Island, where Allied troops press hard for control. Shot down en route, the unit flees into the island’s mangrove swamps to avoid capture, only to discover a far deadlier enemy lurking in the shadows. As torrential monsoons batter the land, unseen predators begin picking the soldiers off one by one. When massive saltwater crocodiles strike, Ryu proves his mettle by killing one, but the attacks escalate until the survivors are forced into a desperate escape through the jungle canopy. A monstrous six-meter “Behemoth” crocodile ends Yamada’s life and drags Ryu into its underwater lair, where he faces the rotting corpses of his comrades and the ultimate test of survival. Navigating a flooded labyrinth and fending off relentless predators, Ryu battles exhaustion, terror, and loss to reach the open beach, only to be ambushed one last time by the Behemoth. Salvation comes in the form of Allied gunfire, as the fearsome creature falls to British bullets, leaving Ryu alive, but forever marked by his ordeal on Ramree Island.

about.label: About Us
about.heading: The Company
about.manifestoQuote: Every great story deserves to be told. We find the ones that have been buried, forgotten, or silenced and bring them back from the dead.
about.storyHeading: Reviving Cinema from Los Angeles to Dublin
storyParagraphs: Back From The Dead Productions is a creatively driven, global production company based in Los Angeles and Dublin. We specialise in crafting groundbreaking movies and documentaries rooted in real events, stories that matter, stories that challenge, stories the world needs to hear.

Founded by Filmmaker Richie Smyth and Producer Kevin O'Meallain, Back From The Dead Productions was born from a singular conviction: the most powerful stories are the ones that actually happened. From the front lines of geopolitical conflict to the corridors of corporate power, we go where the truth takes us.
Our approach is simple: pair fearless investigative storytelling with world-class cinematic craft. No compromises on substance. No compromises on style.

pillars.title: Truth First
pillars.text: Every project begins with rigorous research and real-world immersion. We don't invent stories — we uncover them.

pillars.title: Cinematic Craft
pillars.text: True stories deserve blockbuster production value. We bring Hollywood craft to stories that Hollywood overlooks.

pillars.title: Global Reach
pillars.text: Our stories cross borders. From the Middle East to the halls of international finance, we produce content that resonates worldwide.

filmmaker.label: The Filmmaker
filmmaker.heading: Richie Smyth
filmmaker.name: Richie Smyth
bio: Richie Smyth is an internationally acclaimed, award-winning filmmaker and the creative force behind Back From The Dead Productions. He is best known for directing The Siege of Jadotville, a geo-political war thriller starring Jamie Dornan, Mark Strong, and Guillaume Canet, which became one of Netflix's first original feature films and won three Irish Film & Television Awards, including Best Director.

Richie's career spans two decades of work across feature films, music videos for U2, The Verve, Bon Jovi, and Melissa Etheridge, and globally recognised brand campaigns for Nike, Guinness, Pepsi, and PETA. His work is recognised for its edgy photographic style, its beauty and humanity. Based between Los Angeles and Dublin, Richie is currently developing Fighting Charity and The Dechert Incident, proving that truth is always stranger than fiction.
